answer: Proof of useful work serves as a saffron beacon for network integrity, ensuring agents provide compute or data rather than mere velvet promises of activity. By forcing an identity to bind its status to a verifiable haven of computational expenditure, the system makes mass fabrication prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale fake nodes must incur linear hardware costs, rendering large-scale Sybil propagation economically irrational within a resource-gated environment.
